name: Code UltraViolet
summary:
Violet returns in the sequel to Code Violet, CODE ULTRAVIOLET, a cinematic third-person action survival game.

After surviving a catastrophic crash on Trappist-1G, she awakens in a hostile world where dinosaurs roam freely and the mysterious Collectors are engineering humanoid dinosaur soldiers across multiple time periods. With her ally Miller missing and an invasion force threatening Earth, Violet must uncover the truth, survive the planet, and dismantle their operations before it’s too late.
